metadata.title: About — Olivier Rasolomanana
metadata.description: Olivier Rasolomanana is a product engineer who turns early ideas into clear, usable web and mobile software.

title: The bridge between product intent and working software.
intro: I'm Olivier — a product-minded engineer who turns early ideas into clear, useful web and mobile products. I care about judgment, execution, and software that stays easy to improve.

items.title: Ideas into decisions
items.body: I turn unclear ideas into product decisions people can actually use and build on.

items.title: Simple enough to evolve
items.body: I keep systems simple enough to keep changing after launch, not just to ship once.

items.title: Steady, with intent
items.body: I move steadily without losing the reason behind the work or the people it serves.

timeline.title: A product engineering journey, not a list of roles.

items.title: Four products live, built independently
items.description: Building and running Gando, Cléo Network, Kididraw and Mallow for founders: fintech, marketplace, edtech and mobile, each taken from idea to production.

items.title: Graduated and went independent
items.description: Finished my licence in software engineering and databases at ENI, wrapped up my role at Fedhubs, and started working directly with founders as a product engineer.

items.title: Shipped Fedhubs and Fedhubs Pro
items.description: Built the cross-platform restaurant discovery and booking app, and the operations platform restaurants use for profiles, reservations and loyalty cards.

items.title: From intern to full-stack developer
items.description: Joined Fedhubs as a front-end intern in March, building a web app to help Paris restaurants get found, and moved to full-stack developer in July. Same year: finalist in ENI's internal hackathon and my Prompt AI side project.

items.title: Started computer science at ENI
items.description: Began my software engineering studies at the École Nationale d'Informatique: algorithms, databases, web and mobile. Finalist in an ENI algorithm competition in 2022, with my first freelance and personal projects alongside.
